board_blurb: Bar length is how many sources stand behind the duty, and the colours are what kind of authority they are, because seven circuit courts and seven bar opinions are not the same claim. The order is how WELL SUPPORTED each one is, not how much it matters to you. A duty resting on seven circuit courts ranks above one resting on two trial orders. Which of them you should do FIRST is a different question, and it depends on your firm.
